source_summary: Vertical ink landscape with inscriptions and seals above/around the painted scene; motif extraction excludes all calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture. The reusable painted elements are misty distant mountains, broad water washes, foreground rocks, trees, pavilion, bamboo/shrubs, and a small right-side boat or landing.

motifs.name: distant_central_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the main distant mountain massif across the upper middle: the high central peak, adjacent right ridges, pale side slopes, darker dotted tree line along the base, and soft foothill washes.
must_preserve: pale ink contour lines on the peak
vertical and diagonal wrinkle strokes on slopes
dark clustered foliage dots at the mountain foot

motifs.name: distant_left_hill_range
motifs.description: Isolate the lower left distant hills and shoreline: shallow layered peaks, low sloping ridges, faint horizontal shore bands, and the small dark tree-dot path rising toward the central foothills.
must_preserve: horizontal waterline strokes below the hills
scattered black dots marking distant trees
misty separation between overlapping hill layers

motifs.name: middle_lake_wash
motifs.description: Isolate the broad middle water surface beneath the mountains, keeping only the open horizontal ink washes and faint shoreline bands, without the foreground trees or buildings.
must_preserve: subtle darker shore streaks near the mountain base
feathered edges where water meets distant land

motifs.name: left_midground_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the small dark islet on the left side of the lake: low rocks, clustered shrubs, and a few tiny upright twig-like strokes emerging from the water.
must_preserve: soft water wash surrounding the islet

motifs.name: central_tall_tree_group
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant foreground tree group: the tall central bare trunk with broken branches, dotted bark texture, the adjacent slender trunk, and the darker drooping-leaf tree beside it.
must_preserve: dense black bark dots climbing the trunk
angular bare branches at the top
thin side branches with sparse leaf dots
drooping darker leaf clusters on the neighboring tree

motifs.name: left_foreground_rock_shrub
motifs.description: Isolate the large left foreground rock and shrub cluster: rounded boulder forms, dark crevice wash, black moss dots, and leafy shrub stems rising from the rock.
must_preserve: heavy black wash in the central crevice
leafy shrub silhouettes with clustered dark leaves
small dry-brush accents at the lower edge

motifs.name: waterside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small waterside pavilion or cottage under the trees: slanted roof, rectangular wall panels, simple post structure, and the faint adjoining covered passage extending to the right.
must_preserve: faint receding roofline of the right-side passage
soft ink wash tying the building to the bank

motifs.name: right_bank_boat_reeds
motifs.description: Isolate the pale right-side bank with sparse reeds and the small narrow boat or landing: light shrub texture, horizontal plank-like boat strokes, and the small dark bank accents near the water.
must_preserve: narrow parallel boat or landing lines
small dark ink accents at the bank
misty open space around the forms

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
